text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, the groundskeeping committee is

conducting its monthly academy
cleanup. Nishino
Flower and Grass
Wonder are doing their rounds.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You needn't be so nervous, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I know... but today's the
groundskeeping
committee's big day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best so that everyone
will
understand the importance of
keeping the
academy spick-and-span!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower appears far more fired up
than
usual. I'm a little concerned, so I
decide to keep
an eye on her from a
distance.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, I was using that broom!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I don't see your name on it! Just go get
another
one.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-um... Excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I was in the middle of sweeping already, so why do I have to go? You go get another one!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Umm... Please stop fighting...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: A word, if I may?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for being so passionate about
keeping
our academy looking pristine.
However...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Beautiful landscapes are created by
beautiful
hearts. Let's cease this
bickering and work
together toward our
goal.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, that about does it for our rounds.
All that's
left is...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Grass? Thank you for what you did
back
there! How, um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
How can I become as good as you are at
dealing
with others?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a dependable Umamusume
who
everyone can count on!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you for the compliment.
Everything
comes down to experience,
but if I had to say...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
First, you should stand tall and speak
with
confidence. People are bound to
lend an ear to a
dignified speaker.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Next—and this is the most important
thing...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You need to convey the passion that you
hold
toward cleaning. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The passion I have?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If you can manage that, you'll be
just fine.
Now, the slackers tend to
gather on the roof.
Shall we pay them a
visit?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Oh, it's an upperclassman... And she
looks
angry... But I have to stay firm.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um! Please get back to cleaning!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Why? It's not like I'd make much of a
difference
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...We can't expect to produce great
results unless
we maintain a great
environment!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And I believe you have to create that

environment yourself! You can't simply
sit there
and expect others to do it for
you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'd appreciate it if you'd go back to your
assigned
space and start cleaning,
please!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Fine. Who am I to argue in the face of that passion...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We're done for the day. You handled
yourself
well back there, Flower.
Don't
you agree, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer!
choice_data_list: ……もしかして、ずっとバレてた？
choice_data_list_en: ...Wait, did you know the whole time?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Wait, have you been watching me
from the
start?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Wait, have you been watching me
from the
start?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... I've still got a long way to go
before I can
catch up to Grass!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
She's gentle and soft-spoken, but
everyone hears
her loud and clear...
That's how I want to be!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, if you're using me as
inspiration, then
I'll have to pay closer
attention to my own
conduct.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, I didn't mean to put pressure on
you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, that's not what I'm saying. I was
simply
implying that we should both give
it our best.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
O-okay! You can count on me to give it
my all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: D-do you really think so?! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That phrase came to me in the middle of
a race,
actually.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The well-kept turf felt great under my
cleats, and
I was beating all my old
times...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's when it hit me! "A great
environment leads
to great results."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see. I suppose I've learned something
today as
well.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, that's nothing compared to
what you
taught me! I truly appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems they both learned something
important
from one another.
